rule: Three data tables carry the feel. (a) bands_by_leader maps a leader monster to a band of followers with a size range, a natural-leader flag and branch conditions; a branch-specific weighted pick (lair: yak band 2-5 weight 3, death-yak band 1-2 weight 1, dream-sheep band 2-4 weight 1) overrides it. (b) An ambush reveal gate queues hidden lurkers and places them only when 3 are ready, or a visible tough threat exists, or 3 visible threats are near, or at most one threat is unseen. (c) Camp and guardian stamps are small ASCII layouts with a monster list and a patrolling tag; a serial vault places 4-6 camps at depth 5-10 with 10 percent chance. All numbers are donor values, kept as data fields with null donor value because the donor is GPLv2+ code.
keep: reveal gate as a queue plus threshold, so the player meets a trickle
leader-keyed follower bands with branch weights
patrolling tag as a group that walks a route
statue ring around a unique item on an altar as the guardian read
ASCII stamps for layout and silhouette
change: 8-24 member ambush becomes at most 3 active attackers plus a queue
turn-based timer units become fight ticks on the server
donor monster names, vault names and band names are replaced by our own
look_test: One stub zone, three templates along a 20-second walk: a four-hut camp with a sergeant and two patrolling; an 8-member ambush that reveals 3 at a time inside about 6 tiles; a guardian altar with a unique item and two statues. Dom judges on a 375-wide phone: surprise, camp readability at 6 tiles, altar as reward. Then compare ambush active cap 2, 3 and 4.
licence_note: Code GPLv2 or later (LICENSE, README line 96). Data under dat/ under the general GPLv2+ statement (AU011 class B). Assets mixed and not used. Inspiration category-level only; no names, no published constants, no vault maps copied. No legal conclusions.
